method: Review pinned vendor source and historical documentation offline. Source-authored synthetic fixtures and explicit boundary controls precede engine execution. No measurement callbacks are requested.
limitations: All checks are producer-profile warnings. None proves remote acceptance or complete collector coverage.
Only default exact hosts and reviewed routes are claimed. Configured domains and adjacent transports remain excluded.
Privacy fields can be omitted or empty. Opaque runtime IDs and optional metadata stay optional. Empty key hashes are intentional.
The SDK emits text/plain JSON. Bundle payloads and compressed event formats are excluded.

implemented_scope.description: Warning-only shape checks for the pinned browser SDK POST /rec/page on its default recorder host. The actual transport is text/plain containing JSON. Scrubbed and omitted privacy fields, empty key hashes and optional identity fields are preserved. Bundle encoding, custom hosts, session validity and receiver rejection policy remain external.
